title: Streamline and manage custom fields options in your site
description: You can now scan for custom field options that aren't used in any work items or workflows by using tools that optimize your site. These tools let you bulk-disable them in one action, so you can keep each field under the 20,000 option limit. This ensures performance in your space stays predictable as your site grows.
